title: The Subjunctive Mood
completion_message: ¡Extraordinario! El Subjuntivo es una de las formas más formales y sofisticadas del inglés. Dominar frases como 'It is essential that he BE present' o 'I recommend that the board CONSIDER this' es la marca de un escritor y orador de élite corporativa.

parts.visual:
El Subjuntivo se usa en inglés formal para expresar deseos, recomendaciones, necesidades y exigencias. En el Subjuntivo, el verbo NO lleva 's' en la tercera persona y se usa la forma base. 

Subjuntivo PRESENTE (base form para todos los sujetos): 
- It is essential that he BE present. (No: 'is') 
- I recommend that the board CONSIDER this proposal. (No: 'considers') 
- It is vital that everyone ARRIVE on time. (No: 'arrives') 
Palab. clave: essential, vital, crucial, important, necessary, recommend, suggest, insist, require, demand.
parts.audio: The Subjunctive is used in formal English to express wishes, recommendations, needs, and demands. In the Subjunctive, the verb does NOT take an 's' in the third person; instead, the base form is used. Present Subjunctive examples: It is essential that he BE present, NOT 'is'. I recommend that the board CONSIDER this proposal, NOT 'considers'. It is vital that everyone ARRIVE on time, NOT 'arrives'. Key trigger words are: essential, vital, crucial, important, necessary, recommend, suggest, insist, require, and demand.

parts.visual:
Subjuntivo PASADO (Were para todos los sujetos - ya visto en condicionales): 
- If I WERE the CEO, I would cut costs. (No: 'was') 
- She acts as if she WERE the director. (No: 'was') 

NOTA IMPORTANTE: En el subjuntivo formal, siempre se usa WERE (no WAS) para todos los sujetos (I/he/she/it), tanto en condicionales como en las estructuras 'as if / as though / wish'. 
Ej: I wish he WERE more flexible in negotiations.
parts.audio: Past Subjunctive uses WERE for all subjects, which you have already seen in conditional sentences. Examples: If I WERE the CEO, I would cut costs, NOT 'was'. She acts as if she WERE the director, NOT 'was'. IMPORTANT: In formal subjunctive, always use WERE, not WAS, for all subjects including I, he, she, and it. This applies to conditionals and to structures like 'as if', 'as though', and 'I wish'. For example: I wish he WERE more flexible in negotiations.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma de Subjuntivo correcta.

questions.question: It is essential that every employee ____ the new compliance training. (Subjuntivo presente).
questions.explanation: Subjuntivo presente: forma base, sin -s. It is essential that he/she COMPLETE.

questions.question: The board recommends that the CEO ____ the merger proposal immediately. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Recommend + that + sujeto + BASE FORM. The CEO REVIEW (sin -s).

questions.question: I wish the client ____ more open to negotiation. (Subjuntivo pasado - deseo).
questions.explanation: I wish + Past Subjunctive. Siempre WERE (no was) en registro formal.

questions.question: It is vital that the report ____ submitted before the deadline. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Subjuntivo con pasiva: It is vital that the report BE submitted.

questions.question: The committee insists that the director ____ from the board immediately. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Insist that + BASE FORM. The director RESIGN (sin -s).

questions.question: If I ____ the manager, I would implement a new HR policy. (Subjuntivo pasado - condicional).
questions.explanation: Subjuntivo en condicional: IF + WERE (no was), para todos los sujetos.

questions.question: It is crucial that the contract ____ reviewed by a lawyer before signing. (Pasiva + Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: BE + past participle (pasiva subjuntiva). It is crucial that it BE reviewed.

questions.question: She acts as if she ____ the owner of the company. (Subjuntivo - as if).
The auditor demanded that all records ____ made available immediately. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Demand that + BASE FORM (be = forma base del verbo to be).

questions.question: It is necessary that the team ____ additional training this quarter. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: It is necessary that + BASE FORM. The team RECEIVE.

questions.question: I suggest that she ____ a formal complaint with the HR department. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Suggest that + BASE FORM. She FILE (sin -s).

questions.question: I wish the economy ____ more stable right now. (Wish + Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: I wish + WERE (no was). Subjuntivo formal.

questions.question: The regulations require that all employees ____ background checks. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Require that + BASE FORM. All employees UNDERGO.

questions.question: He speaks as if he ____ the most experienced person in the room. (As if + Subjuntivo).
It is important that the manager ____ all team members fairly. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: It is important that + BASE FORM. The manager TREAT.

questions.question: The CEO proposes that the company ____ a new sustainability strategy. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: Propose that + BASE FORM. The company ADOPT.

questions.question: I wish my boss ____ more understanding during difficult projects. (Wish).
The contract stipulates that all disputes ____ resolved through arbitration. (Subjuntivo legal).
questions.explanation: Stipulate that + BE + past participle (pasiva subjuntiva).

questions.question: It is imperative that the board ____ an emergency meeting this week. (Subjuntivo).
questions.explanation: It is imperative that + BASE FORM. The board CALL.

questions.question: She looks as though she ____ carrying the weight of the entire company. (As though).
questions.explanation: As though + WERE (Past Subjunctive formal, igual que 'as if').

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la forma de Subjuntivo correcta.

questions.question: It is essential that he ____ present. (Subjuntivo - be)
I recommend that she ____ a lawyer. (Subjuntivo - hire)
I wish he ____ more flexible. (Wish - were)
If I ____ the CEO, I'd change this. (Condicional subjuntivo - were)
It is vital that the report ____ submitted. (Pasiva - be)
She insists that he ____ immediately. (Subjuntivo - resign)
It is crucial that they ____ this clause. (Subjuntivo - review)
He acts as if he ____ the boss. (As if - were)
The law requires that all staff ____ tested. (Pasiva - be)
It is imperative that the board ____ now. (Subjuntivo - act)
